description:
One backpack. Seven years. Mountains, airports, commutes, bike rides, weekend trips—even diaper bag duty.

In this episode of Top Notch, Forbes Vetted staff writer Steven John explains why the Cotopaxi Allpa 28L has been his go-to backpack for nearly everything. It’s compact enough for everyday use, spacious enough for short trips, organized enough for work travel and rugged enough for real adventures.

With smart compartments, a laptop sleeve, anti-theft zippers, a trolley sleeve, comfortable straps and durable recycled materials, the Allpa 28L does what most “do-it-all” backpacks only promise: it actually does it all.

Watch the full review to see why this $200 pack has earned our Top Notch stamp of approval.

What backpack should we test next? Drop it in the comments.

author: Forbes
description:
Forbes' Alex York sits down with Grace Beverley—founder of sustainable activewear brand TALA, fitness app Shreddy, and host of the Working Hard, Hardly Working podcast. Grace opens up about her unique journey transitioning from a digital creator to the CEO of a multi-million-dollar apparel empire. Beverley breaks down the unglamorous realities of scaling a business, the strategic decision to transition TALA into brick-and-mortar retail, and the challenges female founders face when pitching venture capitalists. Plus, Grace shares her ultimate daily productivity hack to stop feeling like a "headless chicken" and get more done without burning out.

author: Forbes
description:
In this inspiring conversation, Entrepreneur, Philanthropist and Humanitarian Kathy Ireland shares her journey from international supermodel to one of America’s most successful entrepreneurs. 

Drawing on lessons from her father and decades of business experience, she discusses the importance of hard work, integrity, resilience, and surrounding yourself with great people.
Ireland reflects on overcoming skepticism, turning rejection into motivation, and building a company focused on delivering practical solutions for families and businesses. She also introduces the Ireland Founder Circle, a new platform designed to help entrepreneurs grow, learn, and connect with experienced leaders.

The program concludes with a special recognition ceremony honoring Forbes’ 2026 Self-Made leaders, celebrating individuals whose vision, perseverance, and impact have helped shape industries and communities.
